en-US.description:
Daily affirmations for confidence, gratitude and self love, one calm card at a time.

Every morning SayBright greets you with an affirmation from the topics you care about most. Swipe through beautiful cards, save your favorites and come back tomorrow for a fresh one.

DAILY AFFIRMATIONS FOR EVERY PART OF LIFE
Over 340 carefully written affirmations across 10 categories: Confidence, Gratitude, Morning Energy, Self Love, Career Growth, Relationships, Health and Body, Wealth and Abundance, Calm and Anxiety Relief, and Creativity.

SAY IT IN YOUR OWN VOICE
Record any affirmation in your own voice and play it back whenever you need it. Hearing your own words is a simple way to make positive self talk stick.

WRITE YOUR OWN
Write personal affirmations in My Affirmations and keep the words that move you most next to the ones we wrote for you.

BUILD YOUR STREAK
Open SayBright each day to grow your streak. Celebrate milestones at 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180 and 365 days.

SHARE CARDS
Turn any affirmation into a beautiful quote card for Instagram Stories, iMessage or anywhere you want to spread some positivity.

HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
Keep an affirmation in view all day with widgets that refresh throughout the day.

DAILY REMINDERS
Pick your time and SayBright sends a gentle daily reminder, so your practice becomes a habit.

FREE TO START
The free version includes four categories (Confidence, Gratitude, Morning Energy and Self Love), streaks, share cards, daily reminders and your own written affirmations.

SAYBRIGHT PREMIUM
Premium unlocks unlimited daily affirmations, all 10 categories and every affirmation, home screen and lock screen widgets, recording affirmations in your own voice, watermark free share cards and an ad free experience.

Premium is offered as a monthly or an annual subscription. Each plan starts with a 7 day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. If you start a free trial, payment is charged when the trial ends unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Privacy Policy: https://ramseysmith.github.io/SayBright/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://ramseysmith.github.io/SayBright/terms.html

en-US.releaseNotes:
Premium now starts with a free week for new subscribers, and SayBright can remind you two days before the free week ends so nothing catches you by surprise.

The Premium screen is cleaner and easier to read.

Thank you for saying something kind to yourself today.

review.notes: No login is needed. To reach the paywall: open the app, complete onboarding, then on Home tap the Go Premium pill at the top, or open the Settings tab and tap SayBright Premium. Both plans start with a 7 day free trial for eligible new Apple IDs.
